description:
Perform quantitative microstructural analysis on the AuPbSn40 BSE-SEM micrograph. 

1. The image is pre-loaded. Set the spatial calibration to 0.49 µm/pixel (Unit: µm) via Image > Properties.
2. Threshold the image to isolate the BRIGHT (gold-rich) phase only.
3. Separate touching particles using Watershed.
4. Measure particles (Area, Perimeter, Circularity, Feret's Diameter, Solidity) excluding noise < 1 µm².
5. Save per-particle measurements to ~/Fiji_Data/results/sem_analysis/particle_measurements.csv.
6. Save a segmentation overlay/outline image to ~/Fiji_Data/results/sem_analysis/segmentation_overlay.png.
7. Create a summary text file at ~/Fiji_Data/results/sem_analysis/phase_summary.txt reporting: total particle count, phase area fraction (%), mean particle area (µm²), and mean Feret diameter (µm).
